title: Niamh
description: A ray tracing curriculum with three renderers that draw the same Cornell box, each one better than the last.
about: Code for a multi-part article on physically based rendering. rtsimple is an interactive Whitted tracer in browser JavaScript. rtadvanced is a C++20 path tracer covering MIS, spectral rendering, bidirectional path tracing, Metropolis light transport, photon mapping, participating media, subsurface scattering and a feature-guided denoiser. rtoptimized is a wavefront path tracer in WebGPU, fed by rtadvanced's scene loader and BVH compiled to WebAssembly, with a real-time ReSTIR mode and native CUDA and Vulkan ports.

title: Nemeton
description: An offline-first festival schedule that installs on phones as a PWA and receives live schedule changes from organizers.
about: A prototype built with Cascadian Midsummer 2026 data, for festivals where the venue network fails. It's an npm workspaces monorepo: a Vite + React web app that keeps the lineup and itineraries in IndexedDB through Dexie, with a custom Workbox service worker; a Hono server on Node's built-in SQLite that pushes change batches over Server-Sent Events; and an organizer CLI. The CLI previews every delay, move or cancellation before publishing, CSV imports publish only the differences, and the server refuses a change if someone else published first.

title: Ogma
description: A desktop Markdown editor for writing, vocabulary and linguistic research, with per-section notes and AI drafting.
about: An Electron + React + TypeScript app built on CodeMirror. It shows a document as output, notes, or both, using notes blocks under each heading. A Python FastAPI sidecar, launched by the app with a per-launch token, routes AI tasks across Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible hosts and a local 4-bit Qwen model on CUDA. AI drafts and agent edits arrive as accept/reject suggestions rather than being written straight to the file. It also has an offline Wiktionary dictionary, full-text search, version history, and atomic saves that keep the file's encoding.

title: Portland Tree Data
description: A map and charts of Portland, Oregon's street trees, built from a Python data-prep pipeline.
about: A Python script fetches Portland's public tree GeoJSON, normalizes it and computes summary metrics, writing the GeoJSON and a summary for the frontend. The frontend is a Vite + React app with an interactive Leaflet map, filters and Recharts charts.

title: Deasil
description: The site behind deasil.org: writing, photography and small browser programs, on a Sanity CMS synced from SmugMug and Notion.
about:
The front end is a Next.js 15 / React 19 site with MUI that reads articles and photographs from Sanity. Its programs section has Sundial (sun, moon and wheel-of-the-year clocks on Leaflet maps), Aria (a generative music tracker with instruments built as node graphs, whose Web Audio engine can render a song to WAV faster than real time), Altar (tarot spreads), Glyph (runes and ancient scripts) and Voluspa (comparing translations stanza by stanza).

The backend is a Sanity studio with schemas for photographs with EXIF metadata, albums, nested folders, posts, authors and categories. Custom studio plugins mirror the SmugMug gallery tree over OAuth 1.0a and import posts from a Notion database.

title: Kybos
description: An interactive visualizer for hypercubes, 4D polytopes and hyperspheres in 2 to 8 dimensions.
about: Rotate a hypercube, 24-cell, 600-cell or hypersphere in any of its planes and watch its projection into 3D change. Hyperspheres are drawn through stereographic projection, and the view state lives in the URL so any orientation can be shared.

title: Apax
description: A pixel drawing app built around rotational and reflectional symmetries.

title: Python Full-Stack Curriculum
description: A 15-week full-stack Python bootcamp curriculum, taught to 96 students across 14 cohorts.
about: Designed and taught through lectures, mob programming and one-on-one mentoring, covering Python, Django, Flask, SQL, JavaScript, Vue, APIs, Git, algorithms and deployment, along with career preparation.

title: Seed of Life
description: Circles spaced evenly around a ring, the Seed of Life at six, exportable as SVG, PNG or JPG.

title: Merging Balls
